result.rationale: Both records identify the same incident bladder cancer contrast and HR. The abstract supports validation's population description and smoking-adjustment statement, although adjustment does not establish participants' smoking-status stratum. It does not explicitly establish that participants were free of bladder cancer at baseline, so the JBI q6 difference (Unclear versus Yes) and resulting score difference require full-text review. Human review should also address both records marking the estimate as unadjusted despite explicit abstract evidence of adjustment. No stage resolves all flagged disputes.
result.evidence_quote: adjusted for smoking status and duration and other potential confounders
